rows.definition: The build-agnostic witness function (model.Q8DecodeKernel / internal q8DecodeKernel) that reports which Q8_0 decode inner-kernel tier this host resolved and whether the fused fast-decode GEMV is the active path, answering 'is the SIMD decode lane engaged?' at the /metrics surface.
rows.distinction: It REPORTS which Q8_0 compute kernel tier is active (a probe/witness), NOT the q8Kernel (compute) matKernel variant that runs the arithmetic, and not the coordinator kernel.

rows.definition: The Prometheus metric-name prefix grouping the cold-tool-deferral counters (fak_gateway_tool_defer_cold_total, fak_gateway_tool_defer_turns_total) the gateway emits when --defer-cold-tools marks cold tool definitions defer_loading on the outbound body.
rows.distinction: The metric-name PREFIX/family for the tool-deferral counters, NOT the gateway subsystem itself and NOT fak_gateway_operations_total (the kernel-operation counter family).

rows.definition: The trajctl JudgeClient implementation (internal/trajctl/judgeclient.go) backed by an OpenAI-compatible chat gateway, used by the rubric scorer to obtain an LLM verdict on a trajectory segment over HTTP.
rows.distinction: It is a JUDGE client that dials a gateway for LLM scoring, NOT the gateway subsystem (internal/gateway wire server) and NOT the coordinator kernel; the 'gateway' in its name is the upstream chat endpoint it calls, not fak's own gateway.

rows.definition: The dispatchtick preflight struct (internal/dispatchtick/preflight.go) that captures the DOS kernel loop liveness probe, recording whether `dos loop --json` reports a live, admitting loop behind the dispatch preflight's kernel field.
rows.distinction: It is a PREFLIGHT probe struct that reads the DOS kernel's liveness, NOT the coordinator kernel (internal/kernel) itself and NOT KernelCounters (turnbench) (the dispatch-counter snapshot); it reports whether the loop is alive, not what it dispatched.

rows.definition: The quality regression-bisect helper (internal/quality/runner.go) that returns a ScriptedRunner engine for the demo case with an optional injected defect, exercising the expected-gate path via a scripted engine rather than a real inference backend.
rows.distinction: It is a SCRIPTED test engine for the quality harness, NOT the engine dispatch interface (EngineDriver) and NOT a registered inference backend; it replays canned outputs, never decodes.

rows.definition: The trajctl steer actuator constructor (internal/trajctl/steer.go) that returns a SteerFunc POSTing a steer packet to an existing OpenAI-compatible gateway's /v1/fak/session/{id}/steer endpoint, the production wiring for delivering trajectory-control nudges.
rows.distinction: It DELIVERS steer packets to a gateway endpoint over HTTP, NOT the gateway subsystem (internal/gateway wire server) it targets, and NOT the coordinator kernel; it is a client-side actuator, not a server.

rows.definition: The Windows Error Reporting event class (WER 1001 LiveKernelEvent) that internal/hostfault classifies as a GPU driver live-kernel/TDR watchdog event, carrying a video-TDR bucket-141 or vendor watchdog dump signal, to gate the GPU_LIVEKERNEL hostfault class.
rows.distinction: Here 'kernel' means the OS/Windows kernel (a GPU driver watchdog event), NOT fak's coordinator kernel (internal/kernel); a LiveKernelEvent is an OS-level fault signal the hostfault subsystem watches, not a fak dispatch concept.
